newsitem.title: CANADA: Nuinsco expands gold potential in Ontario.
newsitem.headline: Nuinsco expands gold potential in Ontario.

text.p: Nuinsco Resources Ltd said on Tuesday that diamond drilling at its holdings in northwestern Ontario has increased gold mining potential on its Richardson Township properties.
Company geologists suspected they were missing gold bearing structures with their original drill program, the company said.
They changed their pattern and drilled several diagonoal holes to intersect the zone at right angles.

Three diagonal holes indicated the weighted average grade of the deposit could be about 0.05 to 0.10 ounces per tonne or more than two to four times the grade than previously expected, the company said in a statement.
The best diagonal hole produced about 536 feet, or a true width of 200 feet, which graded 0.085 ounces per tonne, said Nuinsco.
